needs_human.note: excelAdapter replaces the library's own MutationObserver (`spreadsheet.observer.disconnect()`) with one that makes inputs read-only and blurs only elements inside the grid. This depends on a private field of @js-preview/excel. If the field is missing, the library's observer, which blurs whatever element has focus, keeps running.; officeGridActive.ts holds module-global state that the hook layer (useFileNav) reads. A second Excel viewer mounted at the same time, or a later one, overwrites the focus probe, and the first one's dispose resets it to null.

The synthetic click that releaseGridFocus sends to document.body can be consumed by an armed DismissScrim swallow (DismissScrim.tsx:41-45, 59) in place of the real click it was armed for. The real click could then reach the element under a dismissed popup. This was not reproduced and needs an active grid with a popup open at the same time.
